verses.1: And in all these ways, the priests came to me and said, “We will not separate the people of Israel from the priests and Levites from the people of the other lands. They should be treated as slaves by the Hittite, Philistine, Canaanite, Moabite, and Egyptian people.”
verses.2: For their daughters were taken away from them, along with their sons. The sacred seed was spread out among the people of those lands. The hands of the singers and musicians were at the head of this land.
verses.3: And when I heard this, I tore off my clothes and garments. I also removed my hair from my head and beard. Then I sat down in shame.
verses.4: And all those who were terrified will be gathered together by the words of the LORD of Israel, above the heights of the valley. And I will sit in their place until evening comes.
verses.5: And at dawn, I rose up, trembling. With my clothes torn apart, I knelt down on my knees. I bowed my head in worship before the LORD, my God.
verses.6: And she said, “O Lord, I am terrified and overwhelmed with fear. O Lord, my face is turned towards you, for our sins have become too many. Our faults have increased to such an extent that they reach up to the heavens.”
verses.7: Since our ancestors’ times, we have been in great sinfulness up to this day. In our afflictions, we have been given as kings and priests by the kings of the nations, during times of suffering and darkness.
verses.8: And now, for a moment, there was a place from which our God sent us relief. He left us in a holy place, so that we could see our God’s face and receive a little bit of life through serving Him.
verses.9: For we are servants, and in our servitude, our God has not abandoned us. He showed us His kindness before the kings of Persia. He wanted to destroy our Temple and rebuild it in Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.10: And now, what does it mean that our God says this, since we have abandoned His commandments?
verses.11: As you commanded your servants, the prophets, to say: “The land that you are about to inherit is a land of suffering. It is a land that belongs to the people of other lands, and they are suffering greatly from their own greed.”
verses.12: And now, in your children, do not give them to others as wives. And in their children, do not take them as wives for yourselves. Do not demand their perfection and goodness forever, so that you may be strong and enjoy the blessings of this land. Let them be your heirs forever.
verses.13: And after all our bad deeds and sins, You still showed us forgiveness. For You are our God; You have mercifully forgiven us and given us such salvation.
verses.14: Let us obey your commands and live among these oppressed people. Let us not multiply our numbers to such an extent that there will be no more room for anyone else.
verses.15: YHWH, God of Israel, you are righteous. For today, we are still a people of refuge before you. We stand before you in our sins, for there is no one else to stand before you regarding this matter.
